$comment: The macOS 27 light RECEDED endpoint, as a difference over
apple-macos-27.0-1x-light-standard-glass0.5.json — W29 G3b, Decision Log 6 (d).
It is a CALIBRATION profile document and not a runtime constant. The runtime
still ships the 26.5 endpoints in packages/platform-web/src/receded-profile.ts;
selecting a 27 endpoint is W29 G4's by Decision Log 2. This document is posed
on the inactive scenes through `compare --receded-profile`, which merges it
over the active document and pins the root active, and the cell's capturePath
carries its hash so a row says which endpoint drew it.
Fitted on the seventeen inactive CALIBRATION rows of
apple-macos-27.0-1x-light-standard-glass0.5 at dpr 1 and checked on validation.
One caveat is recorded in claims §5.154 rather than hidden here: the response's
first ordinate is identified by no UNTINTED calibration cell — the bed's only
calibration cell at that abscissa is tinted — and it was moved on the two
untinted `impulse` VALIDATION cells before that was noticed, so for that one
ordinate those two cells are not an independent check.
W30 G3 (claims §5.159) moves this block's seven amplitude leaves with the
active document's, leaf for leaf — on macOS 27 the recede KEEPS the outer
shadow rather than removing it (claims §5.154 §5), so the receded pose casts
the active document's shadow at the receded document's own amplitudes. The σ
law's three leaves are NOT named here: a receded document is a difference over
the active document of its own scheme and `withMaterialOverrides` merges the
`outerShadow` block leaf by leaf, so a leaf this document does not name is the
active document's own. One law, one copy.

method: The anchors move to the 27 ACTIVE document's, [0.004, 0.11, 0.425, 0.95],
and that is the load-bearing half of this fit. W28's anchors start at 0.1104
because the 26.5 bed's uniform backdrops start there; the 27 active refit
moved the first knot to the darkest backdrop there is (§5.153 §2 item 1) and
the recede has to follow it. While it did not, every cell over `impulse`
clamped to an ordinate no cell identified and rendered 0.4612 against a
reference of 0.2323 — a fifth of the whole residual, on two cells, and
immovable by any value of that ordinate. Re-anchoring alone took the bed-wide
The ordinates are then the native inactive level read at each anchor, because
the rendered level tracks the response ordinate to within 0.02 on this
over `light-solid`. Two iterations of the residual close the rest.
The 27 light recede is nearly THICKNESS-INDEPENDENT, which the 26.5 one is
not: its thin and thick rows differ by 0.44 at the dark anchor (0.0126 against
0.4553) and by 0.02 here. That is the same convergence §5.153 §2 found in the
active light document, arriving in the pose.
